sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment maintenance inspection I1 which must be performed every 1500 hours of 
operation on the 
Instrument and 
 Control for Water Pumps

This procedure was applied in ABU QIR power plant since 1985, and the 
finial draft is issued in August 2004

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Abd El Salam, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El 
Sadek general director of Abu Kir PS, accepted by eng. Ahmed Taha Hashim Head 
Sector of Abu Kir PS, certified 
by eng. Mona Ahmad El Sharkawy; WDEPC Inspection and Quality Control head 
sector.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
ارتداء معدات السلامة والصحية مثل أحذية السلامة الصحية والسلامة

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Instruments , Maintenance & Calibration
Manometers
Dismantle the glass cover of the manometer
Dismantle the pointer with the special tool
Dismantle the 2 bolts fixing the pointer marks
Check the bourdon tub operation by hydraulic pressure tester

Adjust the manometer by the internal adjusting screw using 
calbrated gauge

sections.text: Thermo - Resistance Maintenance
Dismantle the nut fixing the thermo resistance
Dismantle the thermo resistance terminals

Measure the thermo resistance with ohm meter for good 
 operation using standard table

Connect the terminals and measure the resistance on the 
 terminal connection

items: Dismantle the nut fixing the thermo resistance
Dismantle the thermo resistance terminals

Measure the thermo resistance with ohm meter for good 
 operation using standard table

Connect the terminals and measure the resistance on the 
 terminal connection

sections.text: Flow Switch FSO 128
Check the float direction with the water direction
Test the make and break of the contact with ohmmeter

Check the float arm in good state, and lubricate the moving 
 arm

items: Check the float direction with the water direction
Test the make and break of the contact with ohmmeter

Check the float arm in good state, and lubricate the moving 
 arm

sections.text: Pressure switch
Check the pressure below in good state

Connect the P.S to hydraulic pressure supply tester and adjust 
the pre-set point of the P,S in connection and break using ohmmeter
Check the contact with ohmmeter
Lubricate the mechanical moving parts of the pressure switch

items: Check the pressure below in good state

Connect the P.S to hydraulic pressure supply tester and adjust 
the pre-set point of the P,S in connection and break using ohmmeter
Check the contact with ohmmeter
Lubricate the mechanical moving parts of the pressure switch

sections.text: Differential Pressure Switch's PD0115, PDSA0515

Dismantle the D.P.S from its case & check the bellows of the 
 differential P,S state

Check the set screw is working to adjust the diff. pressure in 
 increasing & decreasing the pressure

Apply hydraulic pressure tester on the switch and check the 
 operation of the contact in opening and closing, readjust if required dnd 
 measure the contact with ohmmeter.

items:

 measure the contact with ohmmeter.
